## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `7e70756fdde74f445e090f4889f105c6fa5e80c0` · 2026-11-25T19:36Z

Seat L1 for card #37227, requested by zone a4-C's final-head note 7172297767 (2026-11-25T19:26Z). It reads dev report 7172218618 and the PR body against GitHub and the tree. No earlier seat L1 or contract review is on this PR. The diff against the merge base `fbb62e1cc` is 21 files, +268/−187.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- Landing: a declared narrowing (`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, three released translation keys retired), handed to the maintainer. The same-head contract review is the record written beside this comment. The PR stays a draft until the maintainer approves; the seat lands it after approval.

**The six items**

- Shape: open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37227`, and no closing keyword binds another card (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37249`). `Fixes` is right: both entries are gone in both states, the keys are retired and declared, and nothing of the card is left.
- Premise, measured here:
  - Removed keys. `released-keys-removed.mjs` against the `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` tag reads 77 keys absent at the merge base and 80 at this head. The three new ones are `home.build.title`, `home.buildWithAI` and `home.welcomeAdminDescription`, each absent in all eleven packs. The locale diff is 33 deleted lines and nothing else. The changeset lists exactly these three, and its en values match the tag.
  - Zero readers. On this head and on the tree merged with `origin/main` `68250f64d6`, `git grep` outside the locale packs finds the three keys only in test assertions that they are absent. No dynamically built `home.` key was found. A code search across the organisation, as far as this token sees, finds no reader outside this repository.
  - Live keys untouched: `home.build.inStudio`, `home.build.noCapability`, `home.welcome`, `home.noAppsTitle` and both remaining welcome descriptions are unchanged in all packs.
  - 「Ask AI」 gate: before, drawn when an ask agent is deployed and the build button is not shown; now, `if (!askAvailable || maker) return null`. The two are the same truth table.
  - Welcome copy: with the build agent deployed, the phone zero-app admin welcome reads `home.noAppsTitle` and the NoBuild or NoAi description; without it, title and description are as on `main`.
- Gates: 62 check-runs at this head: 47 success, 15 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are success. `mergeable_state` is clean.
  - Dogfood landing gate: `landDogfoodGate` (this head's `label-write.mjs`, run read-only) answers `ok: true`. It read the newest trusted `os-dev-report` on #37227, 7172218618, whose `dogfood_battery` opens with `7e70756fd`, 0 hops from the head: 487 files passed, 3 skipped, no failure. The count equals the round-one battery (490 files), so it is the full battery.
  - `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` is clean against `68250f64d6`. K: `landing-k.mjs` cannot answer (no Test Core shard ran on this UI-only PR, so no diff base was printed). Read by hand it is 8 first-parent commits since the merge base, under 15. None of the 8 touches a `ui/**/locales/` pack or the eager-closure budget script.
  - The claim line: the newest `Claim:` comment on the card, 7169264477, reads `declared / yes / narrowing` through `readClause2Line`. The PR body and the changeset read the same.
- The merge of `main` (`b1f7c487d`, parents `230a11df2` and `fbb62e1cc`): two conflicts, both Home test files. Against `main`, `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732` differs by two added lines only, and `HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614` keeps #37166's `setupPair` state and its Studio-only author case as context. So both PRs' pins are kept.
- Accepted deviations:
  - The pushes of `b1f7c487d` and `7e70756fd` ran before `overlap-check`. Both later runs were clean, and the merge with `main` is clean now.
  - The unpushed rework commits `22e09d193` and `7ed857943` were lost with the container and rewritten in `7e70756fd`. Their content is at this head: the welcome copy, the third retired key, the pins and the no-agent control.
  - The merge commit also carries one hunk that was not a conflict: it drops the build-with-ai filter and its gap note from `HomePage.tsx`. The body declares it. `NoAppsAddActions` at this head equals `main`'s.
  - `landing-k.mjs` could not answer; K is the hand reading above.
- Out of scope, and `Skills-docs:`: the line is true for what it names. `skills/` and `content/docs/` teach neither entry; the only hit is a v15 release note that names an agent, not this page. N1 is the one place a doc does describe the removed chip.
- Changeset, read sentence by sentence: the `!` title, the BREAKING line (an override of a removed key no longer applies), the three bullets, "Everything else stays", and the 「Removed translation keys」 list all match the diff. The `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker has the same form as the accepted precedents on `main` (#37223, #36855, #36903). Both `patch` bumps are right: the major is carried by #37223's changeset on `main`, which is in pre mode for 19.0.0.

**Nits and seat-side items**

- N1 — An active P0 platform-checklist item now describes a control this PR removes. `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` (revision 16) `steps[1]` says that where the catalog serves the build agent the Home chip "reads 'Build an app' (data-testid home-build-app)". At this head no build chip is drawn there. `docs/qa/**` is outside the card's file surface and no gate reads this text, so it is a follow-up, not a rework: the seat files a checklist card before landing. If the head moves for any other reason, fix it in this PR with a revision entry.
- N2 — The seat ruling on the welcome copy is not on the card. The dev report cites "rulings 1A, 2C" and the body's 速读 says 「席位关于欢迎文案的裁决」, but no comment on #37227 or on this PR records them. A product copy change is the maintainer's to decide. The hand-off 速读 therefore puts the welcome rewrite to the maintainer as the seat's proposal, and the seat records the two answers on the card.
- N3 — Not said anywhere a maintainer reads: on a phone, an admin with no app on a deployment with the build agent now gets a welcome with no button at all (「Ask AI」 is withheld from a maker). The hand-off 速读 says so.
- N4 — Home's 「New blank app」 chip is still drawn only where the catalog does not serve the build agent, while ruling 7153400210 made the same entry always shown in the 「Add app」 menu. The card keeps the chip as it was, so this PR is right; the seat asks the maintainer whether Home should follow the menu.
- N5 — The body says this PR adds two assertions to `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732`. The net diff adds one (no 「Build with AI」 label); the bare `/studio` assertion is #37166's.
- N6 — Stale comments. Three test comments still call the chip "New in Studio" (`HomePage.aiStudioDisabled`, `HomePage.marketplaceDisabled`, `HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614`); it now reads "New blank app". The block comment above the empty states in `HomePage.tsx` still says admins get "the AI-first magic moment as the single primary CTA", which this PR removes.
- N7 — The body's 速读 ends 「无。」. That was right for a dev draft; the seat's hand-off 速读 asks for the approval.

Not measured here: the dev's four ablations and the 423-file local run were not re-run; the pins were read in the diff, and the head's Test UI shards are green. `check-adr-0087-registration` did not start in the review worktree (no installed dependencies); the head's Check Changeset runs are success.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7e70756fdde74f445e090f4889f105c6fa5e80c0`
Local-runs: probe — `released-keys-removed.mjs` read at the `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` tag against the merge base, this head and `origin/main` (it reads git blobs only), to measure the removed-key list the declaration states
Scope: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/QuickActions.tsx`, the seven test files under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/` (`HomePage.aiStudioDisabled`, `HomePage.authoringCapabilityGate`, `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732`, `HomePage.greetingAndApps-12601`, `HomePage.marketplaceDisabled`, `HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614`, `HomePage.phoneTapTargets-29147`), the eleven packs `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts`, `.changeset/37227-home-drop-build-entries.md` and the PR body's declaration lines (no `reviewFace` hits; on the narrowing face the floor is every path of the diff, all 21 files) + read in the cited code, not reviewed: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAddAppEntries.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs`, the `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` tag, `.changeset/37223-i18n-removed-released-keys.md` and `.changeset/pre.json` on `main`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`

Same-head review of the declared narrowing on PR #37249 (card #37227). The diff against the merge base `fbb62e1cc` is 21 files, +268 −187. Check-runs on this head: 62, of which 47 success, 15 expected skips, 0 failed. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` is clean against `68250f64d6`. No earlier record names this PR.

### ① Derived judgments

**The declaration is complete and matches the tree.**
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand on the PR body, the changeset and the card's newest claim (7169264477). All three read `declared / yes / narrowing` through `readClause2Line`. The arm is the one ruling 7153171432 prescribes for a released key that is retired.
- The changeset carries the `!` title and a BREAKING line that names the consumer effect: an override of a removed key no longer applies.
- 「Removed translation keys」 lists `home.build.title`, `home.buildWithAI` and `home.welcomeAdminDescription`. Measured against the tag: 77 released keys are absent at the merge base and 80 at this head. The three new ones are exactly these, each absent in all eleven packs, and none is restored. The locale diff is 33 deleted lines (three per pack) and no other change. The en values quoted in the changeset equal the tag's.
- Each key shipped in 18.6.0: all three are in the tag's `en.ts`.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` holds. The removed operands are console strings and two page entries. No `packages/spec` schema, registered type or stored row names them, and nothing a metadata author writes changes.
- `Skills-docs: none` holds for `skills/` and `content/docs/`: neither teaches the two entries or the welcome copy.

**Zero first-party readers.**
- On this head, and on the tree merged with `origin/main`, `git grep` outside the locale packs finds the three keys only in test assertions that they are absent. No dynamically built `home.` key was found.
- `useAddAppEntries` on the merged tree has no `build-with-ai` entry and does not read `home.buildWithAI` (#37166 removed that reader).
- A code search across the organisation, as far as this token sees, finds no reader of any of the three outside this repository's Home page on `main`.

**Live keys and exports untouched.**
- `home.build.inStudio`, `home.build.noCapability`, `home.welcome`, `home.noAppsTitle`, `home.welcomeAdminDescriptionNoBuild`, `home.welcomeAdminDescriptionNoAi` and `home.askAI` are unchanged in every pack, and each still has a reader.
- No export is added or removed. `HomeAiActions` and the chip are module-local; `studioLandingPath` loses one importer and stays exported.

**The merge of `main` (with #37166) resolved correctly.**
- `b1f7c487d` has two conflicts, both Home test files. Against `main`, `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732` differs by two added lines, and `HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614` keeps #37166's `setupPair` state and Studio-only author case. Both sides' pins are kept.
- The merge commit also removes the build-with-ai filter and its gap note from `HomePage.tsx`. That hunk was not a conflict; the body declares it, and `NoAppsAddActions` at this head equals `main`'s.

### ② Semver level

- Removing a released translation key breaks a host that overrides or reads it, so it is a major-level change. It rides the 19.0.0 line: `main` is in Changesets pre mode (`next`) and carries the `major` on `@object-ui/i18n` in #37223's changeset, and the package is in the `fixed` group.
- The `patch` bumps on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` are therefore right for this changeset, and they match the precedents on `main` (#36855, #36903). The ruling's premise holds on the tree: no non-major release can be cut from `main` as it stands.
- ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, with the reason stated. That is the route the repository uses for retired UI translation keys (#37223 and the two precedents use the same category). There is nothing for `objectstack migrate meta` to rewrite. The head's Check Changeset runs are success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev question 1 (a no-apps state with no button where AI Studio is on, the build agent is served and no marketplace is mounted): closed by #37166. `useAddAppEntries` pushes the blank-app entry whenever AI Studio is enabled, whatever the catalog serves.
- Dev question 2 (the welcome that promised building with AI, with no button under it): answered by the seat as the copy change at this head. The answer is not recorded on the card or the PR (N2). The hand-off puts it to the maintainer.
- Deviations: the pushes ran before `overlap-check` (both later runs clean; the merge with `main` is clean now), and two lost rework commits were rewritten in `7e70756fd` (their content is at this head). Both accepted.
- Security and permissions: none touched. The authoring-capability gate and the 「Ask AI」 gate are unchanged: before, 「Ask AI」 was drawn when an ask agent is deployed and the build button is not shown; now `if (!askAvailable || maker) return null`. Same truth table.
- SQL push-down: no data-layer code in the diff.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, through the relay.
- Dogfood: the newest trusted `os-dev-report` on #37227, 7172218618, pins `dogfood_battery` to `7e70756fd` (487 files passed, 3 skipped, no failure). `landDogfoodGate` reads it `ok` at 0 hops.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the published surface: it takes three released strings out of every pack `@object-ui/i18n` publishes. That does take something away at the consumer. A host that overrides one of them keeps a dead override, and a host that reads one from its own code gets its fallback. The maintainer ruled this route (7153171432: retire unread released keys in the major and declare them), and the PR meets each of the ruling's conditions: no code reads the keys, the removal is declared with the `(narrowing)` arm, and the keys are listed under the heading the release notes gather. So the narrowing is declared, bounded and ruled; it is not a silent removal.

- `HomePage.tsx`: agrees with the rulings and the changeset. Neither entry is drawn in any state; 「New blank app」, 「Start with a template」 and 「Ask AI」 keep their conditions. The welcome title follows `buildAvailable`, the same signal the old description branch used, so no deployment changes that the changeset does not name.
- `QuickActions.tsx`: comment only. The component has no call site.
- The eleven packs: the same three keys in each, so pack parity holds.
- Tests: each removed entry has an absence pin read after the catalog stand-in answers. The welcome has three cases, one of them a no-agent control. The dev reports four ablations red; they were not re-run here.

Findings:
- N1 (nit) — The BREAKING line names a host that overrides a removed key. It does not name a host that reads one from its own code. #37223's changeset has the same framing; one more clause would cover it. Prose only.
- N2 (nit) — The welcome-copy answer ("2C") is cited by the dev report and the body's 速读 but recorded nowhere on GitHub. It is a product copy change, so the hand-off asks the maintainer for it explicitly, and the seat records the answer on the card. No effect on the contract.
- N3 (nit) — `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`, item `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` `steps[1]`, still says the Home chip reads 'Build an app' (`home-build-app`) where the build agent is served. Internal QA text, outside the diff and the contract; a follow-up card.
- N4 (nit) — Stale comments: the block comment above the empty states in `HomePage.tsx` still describes "the AI-first magic moment as the single primary CTA", and three test comments say "New in Studio" for a chip that reads "New blank app".
- N5 (nit) — Observation for the seat, not a defect of this PR: Home's 「New blank app」 chip is still withheld where the catalog serves the build agent, while ruling 7153400210 made the same entry always shown in the 「Add app」 menu. A maker on such a deployment now has only 「Start with a template」 beside the greeting, and on a phone with no app, no button at all. The card keeps the chip as it was.

No must-fix and no should-fix. Nits only, so this is the final round for this head.
